title: Existence of normalized completed-to-native coefficient maps
statement: There exist a family m of ring maps from (PurCompactSupport.completed l E).ring T to (nativeCoefficients l).ring T for every scheme T, and a family C of CoefficientPresentation l T E i, such that m T = (C T).integralMap l T for every T.

source.place: Lemma 6.8.2 and Section 6.8; normalized presentation construction

proof.text: For each scheme T, choose a normalized CoefficientPresentation using the fixed-scheme existence lemma. Define m T to be (C T).integralMap l T. The defining equation m T = (C T).integralMap l T is then reflexivity.
